strings.name: Built-in hold
strings.explainWhy: Built-in readiness hold at real T-2 h. The count is allowed to stop here for a poll. Real T-2:00:00 compresses to T-2:15 in standard mode.

strings.name: Go for propellant load
strings.explainWhy: Go for propellant load. The count anchor is real T-38:00, before fuel and oxidizer flow. Real T-38:00 compresses to T-1:43.19 in standard mode.

strings.name: Stage 1 fuel load
strings.explainWhy: Stage 1 loads RP-1 (RP-1 / LOX). Anchor for a first stage is real T-35:00. Real T-35:00 compresses to T-1:42.026 in standard mode.

strings.name: Stage 1 LOX load
strings.explainWhy: Stage 1 loads LOX beside the fuel. An upper stage uses the real T-16:00 LOX anchor. Real T-34:20 compresses to T-1:41.767 in standard mode.

strings.name: Stage 2 LH2 chilldown
strings.explainWhy: Stage 2 chills the hydrogen lines. LH2 / LOX is a deep cryogen, so chilldown comes before fill. Real T-16:00 compresses to T-1:34.655 in standard mode.

strings.name: Stage 2 LH2 slow fill
strings.explainWhy: Stage 2 slow-fills LH2 after chilldown. Real T-14:40 compresses to T-1:34.138 in standard mode.

strings.name: Stage 2 LH2 fast fill
strings.explainWhy: Stage 2 fast-fills LH2 once the lines are cold. Real T-13:20 compresses to T-1:33.621 in standard mode.

abortRules.condition: hydrogen sniff above the pad limit

strings.name: Stage 2 hydrogen leak check
strings.explainWhy: Stage 2 gets a hydrogen sniff. A leak above the pad limit scrubs. Real T-12:00 compresses to T-1:33.103 in standard mode.
strings.anomaly: hydrogen sniff above the pad limit

strings.name: Stage 1 LOX topping
strings.explainWhy: Stage 1 keeps LOX topped as it boils off. Real T-11:40 compresses to T-1:32.974 in standard mode.

strings.name: Stage 2 LOX load
strings.explainWhy: Stage 2 loads LOX for the hydrogen stage. Real T-10:40 compresses to T-1:32.586 in standard mode.

strings.name: Stage 2 LH2 topping
strings.explainWhy: Stage 2 tops LH2. Hydrogen keeps boiling off, so topping is part of the count. Real T-9:20 compresses to T-1:32.069 in standard mode.

strings.name: Stage 2 LH2 replenish
strings.explainWhy: Stage 2 replenishes LH2 through the hold. Real T-8:00 compresses to T-1:31.552 in standard mode.

strings.name: Stage 1 engine chill
strings.explainWhy: Stage 1 chills Gas-generator kerolox before terminal count. The anchor is real T-7:00 when the stage is the booster. Real T-7:00 compresses to T-1:31.164 in standard mode.

strings.name: Stage 2 engine chill
strings.explainWhy: Stage 2 chills Expander hydrolox upper before terminal count. The anchor is real T-7:00 when the stage is the booster. Real T-6:00 compresses to T-1:30.776 in standard mode.

strings.name: Built-in hold
strings.explainWhy: Built-in readiness hold at real T-4 min, with a poll before the terminal count. Real T-4:00 compresses to T-1:30 in standard mode.

strings.name: Strongback retract
strings.explainWhy: The strongback retracts because this pad has one. A pad without a strongback does not get this event. Real T-3:00 compresses to T-1:07.5 in standard mode.

strings.name: Access arms retract
strings.explainWhy: Crew and access arms retract because this pad has them. Real T-2:10 compresses to T-0:48.75 in standard mode.

strings.name: Go/no-go poll
strings.explainWhy: Holdable go/no-go poll. A no-go scrubs. An unplanned hold is status 'held' on this event, not a second event. Real T-1:40 compresses to T-0:37.5 in standard mode.

strings.name: Stage 1 tank press
strings.explainWhy: Stage 1 tanks pressurize. The booster anchor is real T-1:00. Real T-1:00 compresses to T-0:22.5 in standard mode.

strings.name: Stage 2 tank press
strings.explainWhy: Stage 2 tanks pressurize. The booster anchor is real T-1:00. Real T-0:50 compresses to T-0:18.75 in standard mode.

strings.name: Terminal count
strings.explainWhy: Terminal count and go for launch. The anchor is real T-0:45. Real T-0:45 compresses to T-0:16.875 in standard mode.

strings.name: Internal power
strings.explainWhy: The vehicle is on internal power because this pad provides that handover. Real T-0:30 compresses to T-0:11.25 in standard mode.

strings.name: Auto-sequencer
strings.explainWhy: The auto-sequencer arms and runs the commit steps from here to release. Real T-0:20 compresses to T-0:07.5 in standard mode.

strings.name: Deluge
strings.explainWhy: Deluge water is up because this pad has a deluge. Real T-0:16 compresses to T-0:06 in standard mode.

strings.name: Staggered ignition
strings.explainWhy: 7 engines light in a stagger so thrust comes up together. A single chamber does not stagger. Real T-0:04.2 compresses to T-0:01.575 in standard mode.

strings.name: Ignition
strings.explainWhy: Ignition at real T-0:03. The ascent sim starts at this commit; liftoff is the separate release. Real T-0:03 compresses to T-0:01.125 in standard mode.

abortRules.condition: thrust below the commit gate before release
engine below commit thrust at release

strings.name: Thrust OK
strings.explainWhy: Thrust is above the commit gate. Below the gate, the count recycles or aborts on the pad. Real T-0:01 compresses to T-0:00.375 in standard mode.
strings.anomaly: thrust below the commit gate before release

strings.name: Umbilical drop
strings.explainWhy: Umbilicals drop because this pad has them, after thrust is in the gate. Real T-0:00.6 compresses to T-0:00.225 in standard mode.

strings.name: Release
strings.explainWhy: Hold-down release. The sequencer commands it; the vehicle is free. Real T-0:00.2 compresses to T-0:00.075 in standard mode.

strings.name: Liftoff
strings.explainWhy: Liftoff. The sim calls it when altitude passes 1 m. Nominal is T+0; the actual is the sim liftoff aligned to that zero.

abortRules.condition: dynamic pressure above the vehicle limit

strings.name: Max-Q
strings.explainWhy: Max-Q is the sim peak dynamic pressure (18307 Pa), not a scripted clock time. The public band is about T+1:07 to T+1:12 on a medium kerolox ascent; this vehicle's sim time is T+0:57.
strings.anomaly: dynamic pressure above the vehicle limit

strings.name: Throttle bucket
strings.explainWhy: Throttle bucket through Max-Q because a liftoff engine can throttle. The sim condition is a throttle below full near peak q.

strings.name: Karman line
strings.explainWhy: The Karman line is the first time geometric altitude reaches 100 km, the FAI boundary of space. It is a sim condition (alt>=100000), not a scripted clock time. This vehicle crosses it at T+3:24, on an integrator step.

strings.name: Fairing separation
strings.explainWhy: Fairing separates once heating has fallen (after Max-Q) and altitude reaches 110 km. Time T+3:35 is from the sim, or from a ballistic coast when the sim stops at burnout below that altitude.

strings.name: Main engine cutoff
strings.explainWhy: Main engine cutoff at sim T+3:51.949. A medium kerolox public anchor is about T+2:25; this time is the sim burnout.

strings.name: Stage separation
strings.explainWhy: Stage 1 separates at sim T+3:51.949, the same instant the sim records separation. The timeline orders it with the cutoff.

strings.name: Stage 2 SES-1
strings.explainWhy: SES-1 because Expander hydrolox upper (exp-hydrolox) is restartable (15 restarts) and this is its first start, at sim T+3:51.949. A public anchor for a medium kerolox upper start is about T+2:36; this time is the sim ignition.

strings.name: Stage 2 SECO-1
strings.explainWhy: SECO-1 because exp-hydrolox is restartable and the ascent burn ends at sim T+10:44.949.

strings.name: Orbit insertion
strings.explainWhy: Orbit insertion from the sim outcome at the end of the ascent burn. A later transfer burn, when the mission has one, is planned after this and is not what the ascent sim flew.

strings.name: Stage 2 SES-2
strings.explainWhy: SES-2 because exp-hydrolox is restartable (15 restarts) and GTO needs a transfer burn after SECO-1. The ascent sim flies one continuous upper burn, so this restart is planned, not a second sim ignition.

strings.name: Stage 2 SECO-2
strings.explainWhy: SECO-2 closes the planned transfer burn. It is not taken from the ascent sim, which has already ended the first upper burn.

strings.name: Payload deploy
strings.explainWhy: Payload deploys after the transfer burn (SECO-2), 30 s later. The ascent sim does not fly that second burn.

strings.name: Deorbit burn
strings.explainWhy: Deorbit because exp-hydrolox still has a restart after the mission burns (2 used, 15 restarts on the engine). The ascent sim does not fly this burn.

strings.name: Scrub
strings.explainWhy: Scrub ends the count. Propellant cost is refunded in Kc; development cost is not.
strings.anomaly: Scrub ends the count. Propellant cost is refunded in Kc; development cost is not.

strings.name: Pad abort
strings.explainWhy: Pad abort when thrust or the release commit fails and the vehicle is still on the pad.
strings.anomaly: Pad abort when thrust or the release commit fails and the vehicle is still on the pad.

strings.name: Recycle
strings.explainWhy: Recycle sends the count back to the terminal count after a thrust failure before release.
strings.anomaly: Recycle sends the count back to the terminal count after a thrust failure before release.

strings.name: Max-Q abort
strings.explainWhy: Abort when dynamic pressure exceeds the vehicle limit at Max-Q.
strings.anomaly: Abort when dynamic pressure exceeds the vehicle limit at Max-Q.

strings.name: Separation abort
strings.explainWhy: Abort when separation recontacts. The nominal timeline does not fly this branch.
strings.anomaly: Abort when separation recontacts. The nominal timeline does not fly this branch.

absent.explainWhy: Crew abort is absent because the payload is not crewed and does not need an abort system.
Methane chilldown is absent because no stage flies methalox.
Off-clock hypergolic load is absent because no stage flies a storable hypergolic.
Hybrid oxidizer load is absent because no stage is a hybrid.
Solid arming is absent because no stage is a solid motor.
Boostback is absent because recovery is expendable.
Fairing parachute is absent because the mission has no fairing parachute hardware.
Stage parachute is absent because the mission has no stage parachute hardware.
Entry burn is absent because recovery is expendable.
Landing burn is absent because recovery is expendable.
Touchdown is absent as its own event. It is the grade after the landing burn, and the ascent sim does not fly it.
Booster separation is absent because no strap-on boosters are attached.
An unplanned hold is not its own event. A holdable event, starting with the go/no-go poll, takes status 'held'.
